comparison.their_best: One model-rewritten brief per phone number, 2,000 characters or less. The update prompt keeps only what changes behaviour, drops resolved items, guesses no sentiment and treats the transcript as data. Read ON, save OFF.
comparison.vp_better_how: A ledger of typed facts. Each fact carries the caller's exact quote, span, audio offset, purpose, basis and expiry. The brief is compiled per call from approved facts, so nothing drifts, and every item can be played, edited or forgotten.

comparison.their_best: Price at the toggle: save to memory costs USD 0.005 per run (INR 0.475 at FX 95).
comparison.vp_better_how: Computed at about INR 0.06-0.15 per connected 3-minute call, because extraction rides the existing analysis pass. The INR price is shown at the toggle, and a next-call preview shows bytes and rupees per contact. To be confirmed on real meters.
comparison.evidence: [O] research/2026-10-21/walkthroughs/retell/report.md defaults ('Save conversation to memory OFF ($0.005 per run)'); [C] data/blueprint/memory-omni-defaults.json cost_inr_per_3min_connected_call_C

comparison.their_best: Memory Groups summarise each interaction and share it across voice, SMS and WhatsApp agents.
comparison.vp_better_how: One contact id across channels, with exact-match linking and shared-number detection. Unverified senders are feedback-only. Every channel episode passes the same quote, consent and refusal gates. WhatsApp data stays tenant-exclusive (Meta s.4.7).
comparison.evidence: [O] data/teardown/synthflow/docs-md/memory.md ('Cross-channel memory is matched by phone number'); docs/learning-automation-v7.md l.26

comparison.their_best: Up to 20 plain-language extraction points, Refresh or Rolling History modes, and pass-through or AI-summarised briefing.
comparison.vp_better_how: Typed default keys plus up to 20 custom keys. Each key has a risk tier, retention and purpose. There is a locked never-stored list (no sentiment), and no sentence-shaped 'suggested opening line', which would be recited. It is shipped, not marketed: SquadStack's code shows intra-call memory only.

comparison.their_best: A first-class contact object, keyed by phone, with a DNC flag and custom fields.
comparison.vp_better_how: A contact id with typed identifiers and four verification levels. Exact match only. Shared family numbers stay separate people, and personal memory waits for identity confirmation in the call. ElevenLabs keys to a browser fingerprint; Synthflow keys to the phone.

comparison.their_best: Contact create with exact-string duplicate refusal.
comparison.vp_better_how: India-default E.164 with cross-format dedupe via the shared normaliser. VP never guesses a foreign country. Pass bar: 48 of 50 messy rows right in under 5 minutes (W2).

comparison.their_best: A pre-call initiation webhook returning dynamic variables and overrides, plus a mid-call contextual_update event.
comparison.vp_better_how: Prefetch at attempt claim, hidden in the ring. Preferences applied as configuration (medium, STT hint, voice, turn preset) rather than prompt text. A purpose-matched 1,200-byte brief with a throwing budget. Memory is injected mid-call only after identity is confirmed on a shared number.

comparison.their_best: An update prompt that keeps behaviour-changing items.
comparison.vp_better_how: Adherence is measured per turn in code: language ID, address lexicon, pace, window, channel. MEM-SIM (200 contacts x 3 calls) gates publish, and a live 48-pair handset test runs before sale. Kill criterion: more than 1 in 20 ignored.
comparison.evidence: [M] docs/harvest/hp-handoffs.md l.36 (stored Hindi, replied English); decision.2026-10-19.tier-plus

comparison.their_best: A retention_days knob, a zero-retention mode and minimal/balanced/maximum memory scale.
comparison.vp_better_how: A per-fact view with play-from-here. Edits are stored as new rows. Forget follows the person across facts, episodes, recordings, channels and a CRM delete, then writes a tombstone and sends a receipt. A person-facing My Data page arrives in v2.

comparison.their_best: A knowledge base fed by web pages, files, Drive, OneDrive and Notion.
comparison.vp_better_how: Evidence-span proposals with human approval. Prices and dates stay in Offering data. Personal records found in documents are excluded. The brain is never mixed with contact memory.

comparison.best_competitor: ElevenLabs (CSV contract) / SquadStack (lead API, failed-rows file)
comparison.their_best: A CSV contract shown before upload, with per-row overrides; a lead-ingestion API.
comparison.vp_better_how: Every field carries authority and a max age. Systems of record win on money; the person wins on preferences. Freshness is checked at dial time (OUTCOME_ALREADY_MET), so already-paid people are never reminded. Data the purpose doesn't need is ignored by design.
comparison.evidence: [O] research/2026-10-20/teardown/elevenlabs/claims.json EL-05; squadstack claims SQS-13/15; docs/integration-contracts.md l.21

comparison.dimension: India residency and DPDP for memory
comparison.their_best: Mumbai origins; SOC 2 and ISO 27001 listed.
comparison.vp_better_how: India-region memory, recordings and embeddings. Purpose and basis per fact. Retention classes. A Rule 3 notice that says what is remembered. VP acts as processor, with a DPA and an audit trail. SquadStack gives no DPDP notice to the people it calls and uses US subprocessors.

comparison.best_competitor: Synthflow (memory shared across agents in a group)
comparison.their_best: Agents in one Memory Group share each contact's summaries.
comparison.vp_better_how: Tenant cohort counts with k of 20 or more feed best-time priors inside legal windows. Cross-tenant priors come only in v3, as consented counts from 10 or more tenants under contract, never from WhatsApp data, because pooling gave wrong winners to 48-55% of dissimilar tenants.

comparison.best_competitor: None measured (ElevenLabs runs its pre-call webhook during call setup)
comparison.vp_better_how: Prefetch during the ring and an opener rendered during the ring. The brief rides a prefix that is cached after turn 1. Gate: memory adds 50 ms or less to p50 and keeps p50 at 1.2 s or less, measured in an India A/B. The effect of prompt size is not yet measured.
comparison.evidence: [M] research/2026-10-17/lanes/l8-azure-bench/round2/results/llm_india.csv (cached 1,280-1,550 of about 1,650 tokens, n=33 per model); docs/harvest/hp-main.md l.216-217 (DB 40 ms, embed 305 ms p50)

metrics.how: MEM-SIM: 200 synthetic contacts x 3 calls with hidden keys. Code checks that each stored value equals its key. Runs on every memory-enabled publish and every release.

metrics.target: p50 delta 50 ms or less; absolute p50 1.2 s or less (kill criterion)
metrics.how: India-hosted A/B, memory on vs off, on the default stack, 30 or more clean turns per arm. Then per-turn telemetry in production, split by memory_loaded.

phases.phase: v1 (launch): know the person from data, honour opt-out and forget
scope: Contact, Identifier and Attribute with DataAuthorityClaim (authority and max age), exact-match identity and shared-number detection.
Source and Receipt objects. CSV, XLSX and Google Sheets intake, using the shared normaliser and API push.
Payment and policy or loan feeds for the first design partners; the first partner's CRM (others under the two-customer rule).
Company brain from the website and documents, with evidence spans, human approval and a personal-data fence (req-30).
Opt-out facts written to suppression instantly; forget requests (verified human intent) with tombstones; retention classes; India region.
Contact timeline of calls and follow-ups; per-contact language from a CSV column; {{memory.*}} slots visible but disabled.
Precheck codes OUTCOME_ALREADY_MET and ATTRIBUTE_STALE handed to campaigns.
Evidence: Retell's misparse [M]; suppression must hold across campaigns (rejected.harvest.07); DPDP duties start with the first recording; req-28/29/30.

phases.phase: Late v1, Plus tier (proposed; owner decision 6): preference memory
scope: Extraction from calls of language, script, aap/tum, name to use, pace, preferred time, channel and heard objections, applied automatically with a 7-day undo.
MemoryBrief with prefs plus a last-interaction line, 1,200-byte cap, throwing budget; preferences applied as configuration.
MEM-SIM publish gate: recall 95% or more, ignored 1 in 20 or fewer, 0 leaks.
Live adherence test before sale: 48 call pairs on Indian handsets, passing with 0 language misses and 2 or fewer misses in total.
India A/B latency gate: p50 delta 50 ms or less.
Cost shown at the toggle; 'What she remembers' settings; 'She knows' chips with play-from-here.
Evidence: Retell already ships memory (parity); ElevenLabs Memory Alpha could reach GA within 1-2 quarters; memory needs one call to prove (L6 s.1 [C]).
Slips to v2 if the default stack is not chosen or the latency A/B fails.
The full Fact ledger: commitments, corrections, stated facts, avoid-topics and up to 20 custom keys, with the memory review inbox and earned autonomy per key.
WhatsApp (24 h window), DLT SMS and email episodes under the same gates; unverified senders are feedback-only.
App and web events with a registered purpose; one recent event per call.
Semantic plus keyword recall (RRF) on an India-region embedding model.
Inbound memory by exact CLI match; identity-confirmed mid-call injection on shared numbers.
Person-facing My Data page reached from the Rule 3 link.
Tenant cohort counts with k of 20 or more (req-33); opt-in dialect style (req-10).
Courtesy thread, only after a listener panel passes it.
Evidence: the owner orders memory before self-learning (req-32 before req-34); spine v2 exit bars (recall 95%, 1 in 20, p50 1.2 s).

phases.phase: v3: learns at scale, still per tenant
scope: Consented cross-tenant segment priors, delivered through the learning module: counts only, 10 or more opted-in tenants, a contract clause, never WhatsApp data.
Compile-policy learning (which keys, order, budget) by the learning module; facts are never learned.
Dialler-history and past-call priors for best time and line hazard, counts only.
More CRMs under the two-paying-customers rule; regional-language lexicons for the refusal and forget guards.
A mid-call memory lookup tool, only if its latency is measured and acceptable; a 2,400-byte Premium brief cap, only if the A/B allows it.
Evidence: pooling conditions (rejected.2026-10-17.cross-tenant-pooling, l6 s.3.4) and volume thresholds.

beyond: Play-from-here memory. Every remembered thing links to the second of audio where the person said it, with the exact quote. No vendor stores provenance per remembered item.

Authority by subject. The person is the authority on their own preferences; systems of record are the authority on money, dates and identifiers. A conflict becomes a card, never a silent overwrite, and she speaks only system numbers, which matters because fake renewal scams use real policy data.

Preferences enforced as configuration and measured per turn in code. Language, pace and register set the medium, STT hint, voice and turn preset; they are not lines in a prompt. This fixes the inherited 'stored Hindi, replied English' failure.

Earned autonomy per fact key. A risky key moves to auto-apply only after at least 100 operator reviews at 95% or more, with Owner approval, and is revoked automatically by the entailment audit or the undo rate.
Freshness at dial time. Payment and policy status is checked at precheck, so people who already paid are never reminded; the launch card shows how many were skipped.
Next-call preview. Before a call, the client sees exactly what she will know (the compiled brief), its bytes against the cap and its INR cost.
Shared-number safety for Indian family phones. Separate people on one number stay separate, and personal memory unlocks only after identity is confirmed in the call.
Memory tested before publish. MEM-SIM (200 synthetic contacts x 3 calls, hidden keys, checks in code) gates any memory-enabled agent; a live adherence monitor runs in production.
The person called can see and erase what a business remembers about them, through a tenant-branded My Data page behind an OTP, linked from the Rule 3 notice.
Data diet. The Data steward shows which columns it deliberately ignored and why ('Aadhaar column: not imported, not needed for this purpose').
Memory-poisoning fence. Values are typed and length-capped, and instruction-shaped text is rejected, so a caller cannot plant instructions for the next call.

Bilingual deterministic guards. The refusal guard and the forget-intent detector work in Hindi, Hinglish and English, in Latin and Devanagari, with negative controls ('abhi mat karo, shaam ko karna' becomes a time preference, not an opt-out).
Purpose-matched compile. Memory from a service call can never personalise a promotional call without separate consent, which enforces DPDP purpose limitation and the TRAI category fence in code.
risks: A wrongly extracted commitment ('you promised to pay on the 5th') becomes harassment on a lending or collections call. Mitigation: commitments are review-tier, amounts are never taken from speech, and earned autonomy is revoked by the audit; collections purposes default to review-only.

Relational recall reads as creepy or manipulative and raises hang-ups. Mitigation: the courtesy thread is off by default and gated by a listener panel; sensitive life events are excluded; objections are only acknowledged, never re-pitched; the no-manipulation predicate sits at the reply door.

Memory poisoning: a caller plants instruction-like text as a 'stated fact' that the next call reads. Mitigation: typed values, a 60-character cap, an instruction lint, and a delimited data block that the compile treats as data.
Family-phone disclosure: the wrong person on a shared number hears another person's commitments. Mitigation: shared-number detection, and identity confirmation before personal memory loads.
Review fatigue: operators never review, so commitments go unused. Mitigation: batched one-tap review, a 14-day expiry, earned autonomy, and a review-burden metric of 10 or fewer items per 100 calls.
Unmeasured latency effect: the effect of prompt size on first-token time is not in our data. Mitigation: an India A/B gate before Plus ships; prefetch and opener rendering happen during the ring.

The inherited adherence failure repeats on the chosen stack (a conflicting default outranks the preference). Mitigation: preferences applied as configuration, the MEM-SIM gate, the live 48-pair handset test, and a production adherence monitor.

ASR errors become 'quotes': a fluent-fabricating transcript would make a wrong fact look provenanced. Mitigation: the transcript of record comes only from ASR finals (rejected.harvest.10); play-from-here lets humans hear the real audio; review tier for risky keys.
DPDP purpose scope is uncertain: whether personalising the next service call sits inside s.7(a) is a counsel question, as is the conflict between IRDAI 10-year retention and storage limitation.
Tombstone legality: keeping hashed identifiers of erased people to stop resurrection is standard for suppression lists but needs counsel confirmation.

Timing: ElevenLabs memory (Alpha tab, 403 gate) and its hidden campaigns product may reach GA within 1-2 quarters, and SquadStack self-serve is 'a flag flip'. Basic memory will be parity; VP's edge must be trust, adherence and speed.
Connector scope creep: CRM integrations are expensive and fail often (17% of incumbent complaints, n=111). Mitigation: the two-paying-customers rule and honest health states (rejected.harvest.16).
India-region embedding availability: the semantic leg needs an embedding model hosted in India; if none qualifies, recall stays keyword-only, below the 0/27 adversarial bar.

WhatsApp terms: Meta s.4.7 bars using WhatsApp data to improve AI except for one business's exclusive model, so any cross-tenant use of WhatsApp-derived data is a contract breach. Mitigation: WhatsApp episodes are excluded from all aggregates.
open_questions: Owner: does preference memory ship in late v1 as the Plus tier, or wait for v2? It depends on the default-stack choice and the latency A/B passing.

Does adding a 120-400 token memory brief measurably raise first-token time on the chosen brain from India? Not measured: every India bench row has the same prompt size. Needs an on/off A/B with 30 or more clean turns per arm.
Is 1,200 bytes the right MemoryBrief cap, or should Premium allow 2,400? This sets the voice module's MEMORY_BRIEF slot.

Counsel: how do IRDAI's 10-year call-record retention and DPDP storage limitation combine when a person asks to be erased, and may hashed tombstones be kept indefinitely?
